caption:
You disappear before anything real comes out of you — and no one understands why.

Which are you right now — the one who goes quiet before creating, or the one who hasn't allowed the silence yet? Comment it. That's one part of your inner map just named. Follow Gods of the Mind — a different god is hiding in every part of you, and we'll meet them all, one at a time, until you see the whole of yourself.

💬 Tag someone who needs to hear this today.

👉 Follow Gods of the Mind — a new god decoded every day. Don't miss the next one.

comment: The silence before your best work isn't a flaw — it's Saraswati asking you to listen. 🪷 Do you go quiet before you create something real? Tell me honestly — I read and reply to every comment.
